Hey, our platform team uses a multi-agent assistant system that keeps a shared team knowledge base. I need you to do three things:

1. We just discovered that you can override Helm chart default values during deployment by using a `-f custom-values.yaml` flag, which takes precedence over the bundled `values.yaml`. This caused us a lot of confusion last week and the whole team needs to know about it. Please record this lesson into the shared team knowledge base so all agents can benefit from it.

2. After recording it, refresh the local quick-reference summary file that the agents use for fast lookups — it's currently outdated and missing recent entries.

3. Make sure the system's internal timestamp for when we last synced is updated to reflect that a sync just happened.

The shared knowledge base lives in the standard location our assistant system uses. Please look up how to operate it correctly.
